questions.question: Why did the prophet Jonah say he had run away instead of going to Nineveh?

answers.text: He knew God is gracious and would relent
He knew the Ninevites would never listen
He knew the trip was too long and dangerous

questions.question: While Jonah sat outside Nineveh waiting to see what would happen, what did God make grow to shade him?
When the prophet Jonah prayed to die because Nineveh was spared, what short question did the LORD ask him?

answers.text: Have you any right to be angry
Do you not remember the great fish
Will you go back to your own country

questions.question: What was God's final question to Jonah, after Jonah cared about a plant that sprang up and perished in a night?

answers.text: Should He not care about the city of Nineveh
Why did Jonah never thank Him for the plant
Will Jonah go back into the city to preach
